first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses both current declines and has prior evidence of durable activation and time-to-value gains. Promotional pricing is responsive to the competitive threat but carries a documented 30-day retention risk that conflicts with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the strongest directly relevant onboarding evidence and the pricing downside before committing.

final.rationale: Run onboarding simplification only for simple-workspace SMB accounts, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts. This directly addresses the declines in onboarding completion and activation, while prior evidence shows durable activation gains in SMBs and faster time-to-value for simple accounts. Monitor qualified revenue and 60-day churn as guardrails. Promotional pricing is rejected because its acquisition lift did not survive the first renewal cycle.
